notes.title: Cyber Sprint Full Release Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

It's here! The full release of Cyber Sprint is now available for all Steam users to buy the full game and play it right now!

Cyber Sprint contains 16 levels each one harder than the last. The goal is to beat the ame as fast you can, and replay each level to achieve a 3 star rating and beat your best time!

Speedruns will be up on speedrun.com as soon as it's approved. Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far, and all future supporters as well. Happy speedrunning!

notes.title: Cyber Sprint Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

I will not waste your time anymore than needed, but I am very happy and excited to announce that the game will be fully released and playable on [b]January 10th![/b]

That's all, that's the announcement. Have a great day!

notes.title: Demo Release In Under 3 Days!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44443394/4148d937798f6f5661b9fd3fe2f9e0538e832ef1.gif[/img]

Hello once again fellow Speedrunners! I am happy to announce Valve has verified the demo, and it's set to release on time, on November 14th! That's just in 3 days!

I am really looking forward to your feedback, and am even more excited to see just how many of your find creative ways to beat (break) the game. If the demo works out well enough, there is hope the game could fully release sometime this December. Maybe an early Christmas gift?

The demo consists of the first 5 levels of the game, so there is plenty of gameplay for you to get a proper feel of the game. 

Don't forget to wishlist if you're interested, and check out my website! cybersprintgame.com
